jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Derby School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Derby).
North Country Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's board page).

sources.note: Derby School Board page (North Country SU, official), 2026-2027 block: Michael Kiser (Chair), Robert Boskind (Vice Chair; the page misspells 'Boskin' -- district minutes uniformly read Boskind), Amber Roberge (Clerk), Jennifer Davis. The same four are the board in six post-election minutes sets (April-October 2026). The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b)); the fifth seat has been VACANT since the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (see Brainard's ended membership) -- the August 18, 2026 minutes record the board still advertising the vacancy, and no appointment appears through October 6, 2026. No per-member term expirations are published anywhere reachable (the district's 2026 annual-meeting warning is not posted).

Derby board minutes, January 6, 2026 ('Board Terms'): Nikole Brainard (Chair) was up for re-election at the March 2026 annual meeting and 'will not be running again'. She chaired the February 3, 2026 meeting and appears in no minutes thereafter; her seat has been vacant since the March 3, 2026 election. Her membership is ended in 2026.
